summary: Preserve the offline-first WHOOP sleep-summary workflow that reads the latest scored overnight sleep from the local activity cache before using the live API.
reason: Some synced WHOOP caches contain scored sleep records in the activity table while the dedicated sleep table is empty. A reprint must keep the local scored-record lookup and live fallback so sleep summaries remain fast and available offline without selecting pending or nap records.
validated_outcome: A SQLite fixture containing a newer pending sleep and an older scored sleep returns the scored record; verify-skill accepts the documented commands and flags.
